positions.as_written: Read opening in extension as implicating the posteromedial structures.
Expect apportionment figures here to be less precise than for a discrete ligament.
Consider semimembranosus function as part of the dynamic restraint.

Treat the posterior oblique ligament as the structure whose involvement converts a medial injury from non operative to operative, and treat the examination in extension as the way that is established.
Address it in a chronic reconstruction even where the acute injury spared it.
Measure the result with stress radiography in extension as well as at 30 degrees.
